title: Meromorphic Solutions of Difference Equations Involving Borel and Nevanlinna Exceptional Values
summary: The existence of meromorphic solutions to various difference equations has been extensively studied in recent years, the precise functional forms of such solutions -- particularly when the function and its difference operators share values -- remain largely unexplored. This paper addresses this research gap by investigating the sharing value problem between finite-order meromorphic functions $f(z)$ and their linear difference operators $L_{c}^{n}(f)$.
